name: Mitsubishi CN105 Climate
description: The `mitsubishi_cn105` component allows communication with Mitsubishi Electric indoor units using the CN105 connector.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: Interval between status updates. Defaults to `1s`. Lower values provide faster detection of external changes, for example when using the remote control.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of this Mitsubishi CN105 hub. Use this ID to reference the hub from climate entities and actions.

config_entries.label: Telemetry Request Min Interval
config_entries.description: Minimum time between consecutive telemetry reads. Defaults to `60s`. This allows keeping a low `update_interval` (to quickly reflect changes, e.g. when using an IR remote) while avoiding excessive telemetry requests (for example room temperature reads). Telemetry is still requested during regular polling cycles, so the effective update frequency is bounded by `update_interval`. Set to `never` to disable telemetry polling.

config_entries.label: Use Fahrenheit
config_entries.description: Configure the climate entity to report and accept temperatures in Fahrenheit using Mitsubishi-specific mapping. Defaults to `false`. > [!NOTE] > Some indoor units use a temperature encoding that cannot accurately represent Fahrenheit setpoints. If the > component reports an encoding error and fails to initialize, disable `use_fahrenheit`.
